correctness.rationale: The rung-state local conditions are necessary and sufficient, zero rungs cannot be adjacent, and each advance between selected rungs swaps the selected rail. Möbius twist makes the number of occupied rungs odd; every admissible zero pattern gives two selections. Double counting by a marked occupied rung gives the exact binomial formula. Formal odd-series differentiation yields the rational series. Exhaustive direct subset enumeration confirms all coefficients for n=3..10, and finite checks are not used as proof of the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: The invariant is the established independent-domination polynomial on a natural classical cubic-graph family, not an arbitrary parameter. The all-order cardinality profile, unavoidable odd-size law, exact number of each extremal maximal independent set and rational series are mathematically informative refinements of the published ungraded total and independence-number extremum. Structural bijection explains the phenomenon and also resolves the minimal-cover size distribution.
